title: The Knight Snags a Queen
setup: Black's queen on c6 is attacking your knight on d5. Moving the knight is not enough; make it hit back.
hint: One knight jump gives check and attacks the queen at the same time.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Ne7+}} checks the king on g8 and attacks the queen on c6 in one jump. Nothing black guards e7, and a knight check cannot be blocked, so the king must move. After {{Kf8}} or {{Kh8}}, {{Nxc6}} wins the queen.

A fork with check is the strongest kind: the king's move uses up Black's turn, and the second target falls.
